requirements.requirement: The system must define a typed UI schema object containing fields: status, case_count, last_incident_date, state_board_url, and score_contribution.
The system must restrict status to one of exactly three enum values: clean, flagged, or unknown.
The system must allow case_count to be null or a non-negative integer.
The system must allow last_incident_date to be null or a valid ISO 8601 date string.
The system must require state_board_url to be a valid absolute URL string when present.
The system must define score_contribution as a numeric value or formatted string compatible with display in the provider scorecard.
The system must ensure the schema serializes into markdown-safe text without introducing unsafe HTML or script content when rendered via MessageBubble.tsx.
The system must ensure all string fields in the schema are sanitized to prevent markdown injection or rendering breakage.
The system must produce a schema shape that can be directly consumed by MessageBubble.tsx without requiring additional transformation logic.
The system must ensure optional fields (case_count, last_incident_date) can be omitted without causing rendering errors in MessageBubble.tsx.
The system must default status to unknown when no malpractice data is provided by the backend.
The system must ensure that invalid or malformed URLs in state_board_url are excluded or replaced with null before rendering.
The system must ensure the schema supports consistent field naming and casing aligned with existing frontend conventions.
The system must ensure the schema structure is extensible to allow additional malpractice-related fields in future without breaking existing rendering.
The system must ensure that any generated display text derived from the schema avoids prohibited terms such as fraud or misconduct.
The system must ensure that LLM-generated content using this schema adheres strictly to the defined field structure without adding extra fields.
The system must ensure that LLM-generated values for status conform exactly to the allowed enum values.
The system must ensure that LLM-generated URLs are validated before inclusion in state_board_url.
The system must ensure that LLM-generated numeric fields (case_count, score_contribution) are correctly typed and not returned as free text.
The system must gracefully handle the exception case where all fields are null by still producing a valid schema object with status set to unknown.
The system must gracefully handle the exception case where status is invalid by coercing it to unknown.
